notes.title: FREE LEVEL PACK! Play 100 new levels and uncover more of Turners past in this free DLC!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25630682/2693e5a43f8758a1d3bf30b00f08fd3db5f76682.png[/img]

We are very proud to announce “The Trial,” a new level pack for Turner! This free DLC includes 50 new base levels, and 50 new challenge versions of these levels, for a total of 100 new levels! Experience a new way to play Turner with a brand new ability, “Blink,” which lets Turner teleport short distances. Use this new ability and all of your other abilities to make your way through a new environment. 

This free DLC is a prequel to the main story, and you will discover more of Turner’s past and how he ended up in the asylum. On completion of the base game (non-challenge mode), you will be able to access this level pack from the main menu.

Of course, along with the new levels there are two new songs. The Turner Soundtrack will be updated to include these songs, plus another bonus song.

In other news, we would like to announce that we are currently working on a Linux version of Turner. We are also working on adding a Spanish translation of the game. This will be coming soon.
We hope you all enjoy this DLC, have fun! ːturnerː

- Love, Bean Boy Games

notes.title: Turner – 1.1 Update (Speedrun Mode)
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! We’re excited to announce that version 1.1 of Turner is live! Here are some of the things we’ve added:
[list]
[*]Speedrun Mode: Upon completion of the base game, you unlock the all new speedrun mode! Race to complete the game as fast as possible, and have your time uploaded to the Global Steam Leaderboards to compete against everyone around the world! There are two different categories, one for the base game and one for the full game. Can you reach #1?

[*]Optimization: Along with in game optimizations, we’ve optimized the way the build is sent out to you. What this means is the game size will be much smaller than it once was. It should now only be around 1.6 GB.

[*]In game level tweaks.

[*]Miscellaneous bug fixes.
[/list]
We hope you all enjoy this update!
(P.S Two of us here at Bean Boy Games have already submitted our times to the steam leaderboards, good luck beating us ːtonterː)

notes.title: Turner – Free Soundtrack Available Now!
notes.notes:
Thank you to everyone for the continued support for Turner! Over the course of the launch, you guys have showed interest in the soundtrack for this game. We at Bean Boy Games have always thought the soundtrack for this game was special, and adds a lot to the game’s experience. Because of this, we are releasing the soundtrack today as free DLC! Enjoy a high quality download of the game’s 14 song soundtrack plus three bonus songs! We hope you all enjoy the soundtrack!

In other news, we are currently beta testing the speedrun mode for Turner and it should be out by July 29th! ːturnerː ːturnerː ːturnerː

notes.title: Turner - What Lies Ahead
notes.notes:
First of all, we’d like to thank everyone for trying out our game! It’s been an amazing experience. We’ve received lots of positive feedback, and the launch is going great! Now to the fun stuff… 

We at Bean Boy Games have already started working on some new additional content for Turner: 

The first thing we are going to release is the Turner soundtrack. We’ve always loved the soundtrack for this game, and your feedback has shown how special the soundtrack really is. We’re hoping to have this out around July 22nd. 

Next, we are extremely excited to announce that we are adding a speedrun mode to the game. It will utilize Steam Leaderboards so you can compete with your Steam friends or anyone around the world. We’ve always been a fan of speedruns, and from the beginning we’ve felt that Turner is well suited for them. Expect this to come out around July 29th. 

Finally, we have something planned that is a little further off. We don’t want to say too much, but it will add more gameplay and backstory, and will be the biggest expansion to date. 

Of course all of these additions and all future additions will be [b]100% free.[/b] We’re gamers too and we know how important after-launch free updates are. 

Thanks again everyone, we’ll see you soon. 
-Love, Bean Boy Games ːturnerː
